messages:
lia: heads-up — deploybot raised an alert during the v3.8.0 canary, text-gen p95 spiked to ~480ms for eu-dedicated pool

deploybot: auto-safety: traffic throttle applied (50%) at 4140001234. alert_id=DB-SAFETY-782. note: pinned pools require operator confirm for auto-revert

lia: change window still open ~30m. do we let auto-rollback proceed (its enabled) or do a manual revert to capture traces?

owen: prefer manual. if quantization/kernel flag is the suspect, we want live traces before we flip the canary

tara: agree. manual gives time to pin and capture trace dumps + full kv cache metrics. also need quick customer note if we revert

lia: plan then: 1) pin eu-dedicated back to v3.7.5 2) run revert 3) collect traces for 15m 4) update release notes + customer comms

owen: pin command (dry-run):
```
redwoodctl rollout pin --pool eu-dedicated --model v3.7.5 --reason "p95 regression v3.8.0"
```

ops-bot: Incident INC-20241210-782 created, owner=owen, severity=low-med, ETA_action=4140001240

owen: pin complete at 4140001242. initiating revert now
deploybot: revert initiated. progress: 45% traffic shifted back to v3.7.5

tara: drafting release-note blurb: "Reverted v3.8.0 for eu-dedicated due to p95 regression on text-gen; investigating kernel/quantize interaction. RCA to follow." Will post on console and update release log

deploybot: revert complete at 4140001249. canary stable on v3.7.5. metrics: p95 ~170ms, 5xx back to baseline, kv-hit ratio restored

lia: nice. next: create postmortem ticket and add a prompt/eval to catch this pattern. also consider temporary tightening of auto-rollback p95 threshold for kv-sensitive canaries

tara: PM-20241210-782 created and assigned to runtime+research. sent customer notification to affected accounts (template: rollback-short)

owen: I'll add the revert and pin commands plus telemetry capture steps to the runbook and attach the trace links
alex: :thumbsup: good comms

lia: thanks all. closing thread at 4140001250
